name: graph-query
description: Query the SAOM knowledge graph. Supports Q1-Q5 query patterns: find nodes, traverse edges, compute skill gaps.

inputs.name: query_type
inputs.description: Query type: q1 (find last attempt), q2 (related skills), q3 (failure patterns), q4 (skill performance), q5 (skill gaps)

inputs.name: query_param
inputs.description: Search term, node label, or domain name depending on query type
